coordinate_convention: right-handed world XYZ; t=s cross d; target d is arriving direction
description: M4B-LIT-001 literature-guided Gaussian proxy, not a reproduction of the paper or a measured PIC/glass external field. L1=10.1021/acsphotonics.5c02702. Target widths use WAFT PIC-side TE 1310 nm guided-mode scales; their air-plane transfer is assumed. PIC source widths are selected to match that proxy. Phase=0, air n=1, scalar polarization and the two-mirror/package candidate are assumptions. Actual case M4A-001 remains unprovided.
